discoveries.statement: Silent coordination overwrites disappear because conflicting intentions remain first-class and visible.
Post-incident accountability improves because every decision path is replayable from immutable records.
Delegation abuse becomes detectable because commitments must trace to authorized roots.
Cross-domain coordination can share one immutable substrate while preserving domain policy autonomy in higher layers.
Some guarantees (hard real-time, strict transport behavior, strict serializability) remain profile-layer concerns rather than core TRS semantics.
